summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Proposal Scheduling (Agendar) feature. Backend: 15/15 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All scheduling UI features working correctly - schedule dialog opens, window/duration selection works, appointment creation successful, duplicate blocking with 409 and amber UI, widget URL generated with correct query params, Agenda shows created appointments.
seed_data_creation: Test budgets, proposals, and appointments created during testing with TEST_ prefix were cleaned up after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Proposal Scheduling feature fully tested and working. Key verified flows: (1) POST /api/proposals/{id}/schedule with {window:'any'|'morning'|'afternoon', duration_hours:2|3|4|8} creates appointment in next available business hours slot (09-13 or 14-18, Mon-Fri), (2) Respects window preference - morning only schedules 09-13, afternoon only 14-18, (3) Respects duration_hours - slot time_end - time_start = duration, (4) Skips weekends - never schedules on Sat/Sun, (5) 409 Conflict when appointment already exists for proposal_id, returns detail.appointment with existing, (6) Appointment has proposal_id, budget_id, client_name, client_phone, notes with proposal value, (7) 422 when duration doesn't fit in any window (e.g., 10h in morning), (8) widget_url contains client, phone, title, proposal_id, value, date, time_start, time_end as query params, (9) POST /api/appointments regression - still rejects overlapping appointments, (10) Frontend: data-testid='schedule-{id}' button on each proposal card, (11) data-testid='schedule-dialog' opens with window-any/morning/afternoon and duration-2/3/4/8 buttons, (12) confirm-schedule-btn calls backend and shows schedule-result with date/time, (13) open-widget-btn triggers window.open with widget URL, (14) Duplicate shows amber UI with 'Já existe agendamento' message, (15) Agenda page shows created appointment on correct date with all details, (16) Regression: /relatorios and /obras pages load correctly.
